categories.name: Bug Fixes
categories.description: Bugs and gaps found during verification

phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Core setup, types, database, basic UI

features.title: Monorepo scaffold with Turborepo
features.description: Initialize monorepo structure with Turborepo for build orchestration. Setup apps/web, apps/server, apps/desktop, packages/types, packages/db directories with proper tsconfig paths.
acceptanceCriteria: turbo.json configured with build, dev, check pipelines
Package workspaces defined in root package.json
bun run dev starts all apps concurrently

features.title: Shared types package with branded types
features.description: Create packages/types with branded types for FeatureId, ProjectId, SessionId using Zod. Export type inference utilities and shared constants.
acceptanceCriteria: Branded types prevent mixing IDs at compile time

features.title: Feature Zod schema with validation
features.description: Define Feature Zod schema matching feature.schema.json. Include all fields: id, title, category, description, status, passes, acceptanceCriteria, dependencies.

features.title: Project Zod schema with validation
features.description: Define Project Zod schema for multi-project support. Include name, path, settings, createdAt, updatedAt fields with proper validation.
features.failureReason: swarm_audit: test fixtures use wrong ID format (proj-001 vs P[0-9]{3}), 14+ tests should be failing (SW-001)

features.title: Session Zod schema for agent sessions
features.description: Define Session Zod schema for tracking agent execution sessions. Include sessionId, featureId, status, startedAt, completedAt, output fields.

features.title: Database package with Drizzle ORM
features.description: Setup packages/db with Drizzle ORM and SQLite (libSQL). Configure drizzle.config.ts, create initial schema file, setup migration system.

features.title: Projects table schema
features.description: Create Drizzle schema for projects table with id, name, path, settings (JSON), createdAt, updatedAt columns. Add indexes for name lookup.

features.title: Features table schema
features.description: Create Drizzle schema for features table mirroring feature.schema.json. Include all fields with proper SQLite types, foreign key to projects.
acceptanceCriteria: All feature fields mapped to columns

features.title: Sessions table schema
features.description: Create Drizzle schema for sessions table tracking agent executions. Include foreign keys to features and projects, output storage.

features.title: Learning table schema
features.description: Create Drizzle schema for learnings table storing patterns extracted from feature implementations. Include category, pattern, antiPattern, context fields.

features.title: Database migrations initial setup
features.description: Generate and run initial migrations for all tables. Setup migration runner in server startup, handle schema versioning.

features.title: Repository pattern for projects
features.description: Implement ProjectRepository with CRUD operations using Drizzle. Include findAll, findById, create, update, delete methods with proper typing.

features.title: Repository pattern for features
features.description: Implement FeatureRepository with CRUD and query operations. Include findByProject, findByStatus, updateStatus, bulk operations.

features.title: Repository pattern for sessions
features.description: Implement SessionRepository for agent session tracking. Include create, update, findByFeature, findActive methods.

features.title: Hono server setup with oRPC
features.description: Setup apps/server with Hono framework and oRPC for type-safe APIs. Configure middleware stack, CORS, error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Hono server starts on configured port

features.title: Health check endpoint
features.description: Implement /health endpoint returning server status, database connection, and version info. Used by Tauri to verify backend is running.

features.title: Projects oRPC router
features.description: Implement oRPC router for project CRUD operations. Include list, get, create, update, delete procedures with Zod validation.

features.title: Features oRPC router
features.description: Implement oRPC router for feature operations. Include list, get, create, update, delete, updateStatus, bulkUpdate procedures.

features.title: Sessions oRPC router
features.description: Implement oRPC router for session operations. Include create, get, list, updateStatus procedures for agent session tracking.
features.failureReason: swarm_audit: 8/10 session router endpoints lack userId authorization (SW-010)

features.title: React app with TanStack Router
features.description: Setup apps/web with React 19, Vite 6, TanStack Router. Configure routes for dashboard, project, feature detail pages.

features.title: Tailwind CSS 4 setup with shadcn/ui

features.title: Zustand store for global state

features.title: TanStack Query setup for API calls

features.title: App layout with sidebar navigation

features.title: Kanban board component
features.description: Create Kanban board with columns for each status (backlog, in_progress, waiting_approval, verified). Use dnd-kit for drag-drop.

features.title: Feature card component

features.title: Feature detail panel

features.title: Feature create/edit form

features.title: Kanban column header with count

features.title: Agent session creation service
